prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: separate closed-book raster object for a literary travel website, isolated on real transparent alpha.
Primary request: One upright CLOSED vintage hardcover book, portrait shape. Nearly straight frontal view, very small left spine visible and a narrow ivory page-block edge on the right and bottom. Entire book visible, no clipping. Compact believable hardcover proportions width to height 0.68, vertical edges upright, no tilt, slight depth, realistic material and warm soft studio lighting. Book occupies almost all of a portrait 1024x1536 canvas with a narrow transparent margin. Fine single antique gold rectangular border with tiny corner ornaments. Carefully painted old-world cover illustration entirely in the lower 65% of the cover. Upper 25% is completely plain cover material reserved for later HTML text overlay. Photoreal physical cover material with hand-painted illustration, tactile and elegant, restrained detail, same geometry as a matched four-book series.
Constraints: NO TEXT OR LETTERS ANYWHERE, including spine, illustration and decorative elements. No logos, symbols masquerading as writing, watermark, label, title or typography. No surrounding scenery or tabletop. No cast background shadow. Actual transparent outer background, not white or checkerboard pixels. Only one closed upright book.
Cover palette: deep dark navy #233a40 leather/cloth with fine realistic grain. Painted illustration: intimate Italian cafe at dusk with one glowing old lantern above a tiny round table and two EMPTY bentwood chairs, foliage and understated stucco architecture, tiny warm amber illumination.
